graphEvents.label: Cross-CLI rank by gain per floor risk
No start delta separable at 15 rows

label: A delivery unknown is counted as an offer that reached the model, because the tally excludes an offer only when delivery is exactly false.

The unknown rule erases OpenCode off-arm counterfactual while the four reader runtimes keep theirs: offerReached off to on is claude 0 of 5 to 5 of 5, pi 0 to 5, devin 0 to 5, dsh 0 to 5 and opencode 5 of 5 to 5 of 5, so five off-arm offers are credited as reached through a plugin that was switched off.
No per-runtime start-rate delta is separable at these arm sizes: the Wilson intervals overlap for all five runtimes, so no start gain can be attributed to the brief from this arm.

The turn cap costs measurement space unevenly and mostly on OpenCode: cappedStartRows reads 8 of 15 off and 5 of 15 on for opencode, 4 and 3 for devin, 1 and 0 for pi and 0 for claude and dsh, so opencode start rate rests on 7 and 10 judgeable rows.

Ranked by measurement restored per unit of floor risk the cross-CLI order is the OpenCode receipt plus reader branch, the Codex arm unlock blocked on operator approval, the ask-representation widening that rewrites prior numbers, then the one-row devin and dsh offerUnknown gaps.
